01 / PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Professional Summary

Cybersecurity professional focused on SOC operations, SIEM monitoring and incident response.

Motivated cybersecurity professional and aspiring SOC Analyst with a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (2025), currently pursuing CompTIA Security+ (expected Dec 2026) and EC-Council Certified SOC Analyst (CSA) to strengthen core security fundamentals.

Hands-on experience in SIEM monitoring, alert investigation, event correlation, incident response and threat detection through real-world lab environments including TryHackMe, LetsDefend, Hack The Box and Blue Team Labs Online.

Skilled in analysing Windows Event Logs, Sysmon, Linux Syslog and network traffic to identify and respond to security incidents using Splunk, Wazuh, Microsoft Sentinel and n8n automation.

Experienced in phishing analysis, IOC analysis, threat hunting and MITRE ATT&CK mapping, with a focus on improving detection accuracy and reducing false positives.

Strong understanding of SOC workflows: monitoring, investigation, escalation, documentation and reporting. Seeking a SOC Analyst position.

👁️

24/7 Threat Monitoring

Continuous telemetry surveillance, alert prioritization, and aggressive false-positive reduction to ensure zero-lag escalation.

Deep-dive SPL and KQL query investigation across authentication events, Sysmon telemetry, and firewall drop streams.
